allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Michael ‘Jay’ Cochran has just left the Navy after 12 years and he's not quite sure what he's going to do, except that he knows he wants a holiday. He decides to visit Tiburon Mendez, a powerful but shady Mexican businessman who he once flew to Alaska for a hunting trip. Arriving at the Mendez mansion in Mexico, he is immediately surprised by the beauty and youth of Mendez’s wife, Miryea.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When mutual attraction sparks inside the guarded compound of a ruthless host, the boundary between leisure and mortal peril begins to dissolve.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After twelve years in the Navy, Jay Cochran visits Mexico to unwind at the estate of Tiburon Mendez, a shady and influential businessman. The stay turns precarious when Cochran meets Mendez's captivating wife, Miryea.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Steamy, suspenseful, and emotionally heavy, moving at a measured pace that demands engaged attention.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Tony Scott, this 1990 thriller blends romantic obsession with looming danger, delivering high-stakes suspense set against an alluring, high-society Mexican backdrop.
